newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Hartamas Singapore shares up 7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sri Hartamas Singapore shares up 7 pct.

text.p: Shares in Malaysian property developer Sri Hartamas quoted in Singapore jumped seven percent, or seven cents, to a high of Singapore $1.04 on Friday following news Malaysia's MBf Holdings may double its stake in the firm.
By 0135 GMT, more than 3.0 million Sri Hartamas shares had changed hands, putting the stock at the top of the actives list on the Stock Exchange of Singapore.

Malaysian news agency Bernama on Thursday quoted MBf chief executive officer Loy Hean Heong as saying the higher stake would enable MBf Holdings to get a greater contribution from Sri Hartamas' bottom line.
Dealers said there appeared to be no other clear reason for the activity in Sri Hartamas, apart from the Bernama report.
